_comment: Designed specifically for the IQ scanner. Maximises the signal each scanner check measures: distinct primary colours for grayscale/saturation, a near-emissive surface for bloom/lens_flare, deep depth variety for fog/DOF, sharp geometric crevices for SSAO, and a frame-filling layout so no scanner check fires over a vacuum.

assets._comment: Key light — bright overhead, slight upper-front offset so vertical box faces aren't fully self-shadowed by Lambert N·L. Also drives bloom + lens-flare via the glow.
Fill light — cool from the opposite side to lift the shadowed faces (red wall, blue box back) into the visible range.
Cornell room walls — left wall red, right wall green, others white. Drives chromatic-aberration, saturation, and color-grade tests.
Foreground box, deep blue. Near depth so DOF will sharpen it relative to the back wall and motion-blur has something close to drag.
Background box, hot orange. Tall + far so depth-fog has range to attenuate. Edge contrast vs the rear wall drives SSAO crevice darkening.
Small emissive sphere right under the light. Its visible-from-camera bright spot is the bloom + lens-flare seed. Placed BEFORE Suzanne so the iq_demo runtime spins Suzanne as the last renderable.
Suzanne (subdivided mesh). LAST in the scene so the iq_demo runtime picks her as the rotation target. Saturated magenta makes grayscale-collapse detection sharp.
